# Offline demo assets

`snapdom.mjs`: SnapDOM 3.5.0, MIT, the published `dist/snapdom.mjs` of [`@zumer/snapdom@3.5.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zumer/snapdom/v/3.5.0)
([v3.5.0](https://github.com/zumerlab/snapdom/tree/66b509406f866fc57994263e26fd15c4523766a8)), unchanged.
SHA-256: `54db58f8edb821edbe389d1fc69b5deccd7bb32e04bf8856e192039aca710bba`. `LICENSE` is its upstream license. These
demo assets are not part of the encoder download.

`nested.html` is SnapDOM's `demos/d8-nested-elements.html` at [f7bb642d](https://github.com/zumerlab/snapdom/tree/f7bb642d83ece9f6efdca0825ab87bb7b2274650).
The fixture generator removes its scripts, sets a 960×540 layout and explicit theme colors, then captures it with the
real SnapDOM bundle.
